metadata.description: The frontend design stack for Claude Code: Anthropic frontend-design, Impeccable, UI UX Pro Max, Taste and Emil Kowalski's design engineering skills, curated, de-conflicted and kept in sync.

plugins.name: frontend-stack
plugins.description: The glue: a router skill that picks the right skill for each frontend task, resolves the rules that conflict between packs, and ships design-director and ui-reviewer agents.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic's official frontend-design skill: distinctive, intentional aesthetic direction instead of templated AI defaults.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Impeccable by Paul Bakaus: 1 skill with 24 commands (/impeccable polish, audit, critique, harden, ...), design agents, anti-pattern detection hooks.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: UI UX Pro Max: searchable local database of 79 styles, 192 palettes, 74 font pairings, charts and 22 stack guidelines, plus design-system, brand, banner and slides skills.

plugins.name: taste
plugins.description: Taste skills by Leonxlnx: anti-slop landing pages and redesigns, plus opt-in aesthetic presets (minimalist, brutalist, high-end, Stitch).

plugins.name: taste-imagegen
plugins.description: Optional. Taste image-first skills (image-to-code, web/mobile design concepts, brand kits). Needs an image-generation tool in your environment.

plugins.name: emil-design-eng
plugins.description: Emil Kowalski's design engineering skills: UI polish, animation craft (animate, review, improve, find opportunities), Apple-style motion, prototypes, native-feeling mobile web, library picks.

plugins.name: emil-native
plugins.description: Optional. Emil Kowalski's native skills: React Native / Expo animation and modern Swift.
